title: Stationfall: Important Systems
summary: Read the Stationfall signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Access cards, pressure seal kits, oxygen packs, AI override chips, panic dampeners, and station route services all shape how long you can stay.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch oxygen, pressure, access cards, seal kits, panic state, route doors, and whether the station has started asking for more time than you planned.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Stationfall system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
